About the Company
NovaTech Solutions is a fictional technology company focused on building modern web applications, SaaS platforms,
and digital solutions for businesses. We are looking for enthusiastic frontend developers who enjoy creating
responsive, user-friendly, and high-performance web interfaces.
Roles & Responsibilities
 Develop responsive and interactive user interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React.js.
 Convert UI/UX designs and wireframes into functional web pages.
 Build reusable components and maintain clean, readable code.
 Integrate frontend applications with REST APIs and backend services.
 Optimize application performance, accessibility, and cross-browser compatibility.
 Debug issues, test features, and collaborate with designers and backend developers.
 Use Git and GitHub for version control and team collaboration.
Required Skills
HTML5 · CSS3 · JavaScript (ES6+) · React.js · Responsive Design · REST APIs · Git & GitHub
Eligibility Criteria
 B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, IT, or a related discipline; relevant students and graduates may apply.
 Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and basic programming concepts.
 Familiarity with React.js through coursework, personal projects, or internships.
 Good problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.
 A portfolio, GitHub profile, or live project deployment is an advantage.
Position Details
1. Frontend Developer Intern
Duration: 3–6 months. Work with experienced developers, implement UI components, fix bugs, learn industry
workflows, and contribute to live projects. High-performing interns may be considered for a full-time opportunity.
2. Frontend Developer — Full-Time
Work independently on frontend features, contribute to application architecture, integrate APIs, review code, and
improve application performance in a collaborative engineering team.
Selection Process
